units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 8:7">Targ. Gen. VIII, 7</cite> (ed. Vien. O. <cite ref="P01258"><he>עָרְבָּא</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 21a:2">Bets. 21ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 124b:16">Ḥull. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>א״ל ע׳ פרח</he> said he to him, a raven flew by (an evasive answer).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:3">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 27:20">Gen. XXVII, 20</cite>) (Jacob through his pious speech came near frustrating his device) <he>לע׳ דאייתי וכ׳</he> like a raven that carries fire to his nest (to warm his brood).

<cite ref="Ketubot 49b:5">Keth. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ בעי בניה וכ׳</he> the raven wants (and cares for his) children, and this man wants none; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="P00351"><he>עוֹרְבִין</he></cite>, <he>עוֹרְבַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="P00351"><he>עוֹרְבֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 34:11">Targ. Is. XXXIV, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 17:4">Targ. I Kings XVII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 17:6">6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 56b:4">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>חזאי ע׳ וכ׳</he> I saw in my dream ravens which flew around my bed.
